correctness.rationale: Every required sign and derivative is reconstructed in RESULT.md. The equal-width logarithmic second derivative is strictly negative for all a,w>0 and b>=a+w. For L>=9 the four-exponential derivative has at most three distinct zeros and rigorous alternating signs in three disjoint intervals, so precisely two strict maxima and a strict minimum. A rescaling comparison excludes the higher-rate maximum as globally best; boundaries tend to zero. The actual standalone checker passed rational bounds, a Sturm root count at L=9, high-precision local checks, and sample curvature checks. No finite result is used as a universal proof.

originality.rationale: The 2022 preprint/2023 de Jager–Soons article explicitly reports simulated fitness valleys in a nonlinear seed-establishment setting, so that broad qualitative observation is excluded from the novelty claim. The distinct precise two-band one-seed theorem combines an all-spacing equal-width strict-log-concavity result, an all-L>=9 classification of exactly three critical rates under scaled widths, and a global ranking of the two maxima. None of the three materially inspected papers or retrieved mathematical result summaries established these exact statements. Broader historical priority is not certified.

value.rationale: The problem is a biologically motivated one-seed landing objective in fragmented downstream habitat. It isolates a nontrivial structural contrast: equal physical habitat widths guarantee a single dispersal-scale optimum at all separations, but two geometrically scaled patches admit a separate locally attracting short-range peak for every L>=9. The universal no-trap theorem and explicit trap regime identify a mechanism for multiple fitness optima, beyond reproducing the prior simulated fact that hysteresis can occur. No field or evolutionary claim is inferred.
